name: watch-for-me
description: Let your agent watch audio and video for you: a complete bilingual transcript and source-linked notes, with local transcription and speaker attribution.

interface.shortDescription: Let your agent watch audio and video for you.
interface.longDescription: Configure local Whisper and speaker diarization, then turn local audio, local video, or online video into a complete bilingual transcript and source-linked notes on one offline page, with video-only visual evidence.
defaultPrompt: Set up Watch for Me for this environment.
Watch this video for me and give me the full bilingual transcript and notes.
Organize this recording with feedback, decisions, and action items.
Help me learn this lecture with notes linked to the source.
